install_msg:
Thanks for installing TwitterFixer.

This is a fork. The original cog was published by tombly and its repository has since been deleted; this copy is archived here so the code is not lost. Nothing but this metadata file changed.

Setup: ffmpeg must be installed on the bot host (apt install ffmpeg), otherwise re-encoding fails.

Usage: no commands — the cog listens for Twitter/X links and replaces them with a vxtwitter embed.

Permissions: manage messages (to delete its own embeds) and embed links.
name: TwitterFixer
short: Fork: rewrites Twitter/X links into vxtwitter embeds.
description: Archived fork of a deleted cog. Picks up Twitter and X links in messages, pulls the post metadata from the vxtwitter API and builds an embed with text, author, date, likes, retweets and replies. Video and GIF media is re-encoded with ffmpeg; when the result exceeds the upload limit the cog posts a vxtwitter link instead.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not collect or persist data about Discord users. Links and post metadata are sent to api.vxtwitter.com; downloaded media is only kept temporarily in the cog's data directory.
